results.title: Robotic Simulation Systems and Intelligent Offline Teaching for ...
results.content: Despite challenges in modeling accuracy and sensor data precision, the simulation system and offline teaching approach decrease metro vehicle operation risks and enhance robot deployment efficiency. In view of the complexity of undercarriage inspection robot systems and the vast amounts of data (including laser point clouds, depth images, and video streams, among others) generated during their operation, this research will first develop a fundamental simulation tool based on Gazebo, which is deeply integrated with ROS, with the goal of exploring design methods for undercarriage inspection robot simulation systems. By integrating key technologies, multi-source perception data fusion, point cloud-based reverse-engineered modeling, and intelligent path planning, a Gazebo-based undercarriage robot simulation platform is established. In this study, our goal is to leverage Isaac Sim’s powerful simulation and deep learning capabilities to build a robotics simulation system that integrates virtual and real-world data, providing technical support for training large-scale object detection models for undercarriage inspection robots.
